# BizPlan Genius

> Self-serve AI platform that generates investor-ready business plans, websites, pitch decks, brand kits, and ad copy in minutes. Built for first-time founders, SBA loan applicants, and E-2 / L-1 / EB-5 visa applicants who need professional documentation fast.

BizPlan Genius produces 12 paid AI tools and 6 free lead-magnet utilities. The flagship differentiator is a plan-to-website flow: a customer generates a business plan, then with one click their website builds itself using that plan as the source of truth. No competitor in the AI business plan category does this.

Pricing tiers run from $19 (single ad copy or investor email pack) to $447 (Full Business Kit). A done-for-you concierge tier is available at $497 for buyers who want a human writer, not a tool.

## Core paid products

- [Business Plan Pro - $147](https://www.bizplangenius.com/generate): Complete AI business plan with operations plan, risk analysis, 3-year financials, and money-back guarantee. Investor-ready.
- [Business Plan Starter - $97](https://www.bizplangenius.com/generate): 7-section AI business plan with PDF download. Best for early-stage validation.
- [Competitor Spy - $97](https://www.bizplangenius.com/spy): AI-powered competitive analysis. 10-15 real competitors with pricing, SWOT, vulnerability audit, and 90-day tactical roadmap.
- [Website Builder - $99 to $199](https://www.bizplangenius.com/build-website): Generates a live website (landing, e-commerce, booking, restaurant, portfolio, or SaaS) auto-populated from your business plan.
- [Pitch Deck - $39](https://www.bizplangenius.com/pitch-deck): Investor-ready pitch deck generated from your business plan.
- [Logo and Brand Kit - $29](https://www.bizplangenius.com/brand-kit): Logo, color palette, typography system, brand guide.
- [Social Media Pack - $29](https://www.bizplangenius.com/social-pack): 30 days of brand-aligned social posts with copy, hashtags, and image prompts.
- [Investor Email Templates - $19](https://www.bizplangenius.com/investor-emails): Cold outreach sequences proven to get founder meetings.
- [Legal Pages Generator - $19](https://www.bizplangenius.com/legal-pages): Privacy policy, terms of service, cookie policy, refund policy.
- [Ad Copy Generator - $19](https://www.bizplangenius.com/ad-copy): Facebook, Google, and LinkedIn ad copy variants.

## Trigger-segment landing pages

- [E-2 / L-1 / EB-5 Visa Business Plan - $147](https://www.bizplangenius.com/e2-visa-business-plan): USCIS-format business plan for visa applicants. Covers source of investment, financial projections, and US economic impact.
- [SBA Loan Business Plan - $147](https://www.bizplangenius.com/sba-loan-business-plan): SBA 7(a), 504, and microloan format. Banker-aligned use of funds, projections, and collateral position.

For buyers who want a human writer instead of a self-serve tool, the $497 done-for-you tier delivers a custom investor-ready business plan in 5 days. Contact eadrianene@gmail.com for intake.
